bugs.title: Wrong package root and missing 'blogs' module
bugs.reason: `from api.v1 import projects` / `from api.v1 import blogs` use the wrong root (should be `app.api.v1`), and there is no `blogs` module in app/api/v1/ (only projects.py). Raises ModuleNotFoundError/ImportError on startup and masks every later error. Line 23 `app.include_router(blogs.router)` is dead for the same reason.
bugs.fix: Use `from app.api.v1 import projects`; create the blogs module or remove the blogs import and include_router call.

bugs.title: Bare import of repositories
bugs.reason: `from repositories import BaseRepository` is a top-level import for a package that lives at app.repositories. There is no top-level `repositories` on sys.path. Raises ModuleNotFoundError.

bugs.title: Bare import of base
bugs.reason: `from base import BaseRepository` should be relative. Even after fixing BUG-02, importing app.repositories runs this and fails with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'base'.

bugs.title: List used but not imported
bugs.reason: `async def get_all(...) -> List[ModelType]:` references List, but only Generic, TypeVar, Type are imported. With no `from __future__ import annotations`, the annotation is evaluated at definition time and raises NameError: name 'List' is not defined.
bugs.fix: Add `List` to the typing import, or use built-in `list[ModelType]`.

bugs.title: Imports non-existent names and modules
bugs.reason: Imports `ProjectModelSchema` (project.py defines ProjectBase/ProjectCreate/ProjectRead, not that name) and modules .blog, .profile, .user that do not exist. The entire schemas package is unimportable; breaks as soon as anything imports app.schemas (the commented routes in main.py reference these names).
bugs.fix: Import the names that actually exist (e.g. ProjectRead, ProjectCreate) and remove or create the blog/profile/user schema modules.

bugs.title: Bare import of base schema
bugs.reason: `from base import BaseSchema, BaseDBMetadata` should be relative. Raises ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'base'.

bugs.title: PostgreSQL ARRAY column on SQLite
bugs.reason: tags/techStack use Column(ARRAY(String)). ARRAY is PostgreSQL-only, but the project uses SQLite (dev.db, v1_db.db). SQLModel.metadata.create_all() fails to compile the column. Reproduced: CompileError - SQLiteTypeCompiler can't render element of type ARRAY.
bugs.fix: Use a JSON column (sa_column=Column(JSON)) for SQLite, or move to PostgreSQL.

bugs.title: create_all runs at import time and depends on import order
bugs.reason: SQLModel.metadata.create_all(db_engine) executes on import and only creates tables for models already registered in metadata. It works today only because projects.py imports app.models before app.db; any other import order silently creates no tables.
bugs.fix: Ensure all models are imported before create_all, and move create_all into an explicit startup/init function rather than module import.

bugs.title: BASE_DIR points above the backend folder
bugs.reason: Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] resolves to the parent above backend/, so env_file points at personal-blog/.env instead of backend/.env. No .env exists in backend/. Because SECRET_KEY and DATABASE_URL are required with no defaults, Settings() raises ValidationError at import unless set in the real environment.
bugs.fix: Use parents[1] so env_file resolves to backend/.env, and add a .env with SECRET_KEY and DATABASE_URL.

bugs.title: Missing await on async repository call
bugs.reason: `result = BaseRepository(ProjectModel, session).get_all()` never awaits get_all, which is async def. result is an un-awaited coroutine, so the response fails to serialize.
bugs.fix: Await the call: `result = await BaseRepository(ProjectModel, session).get_all()`.

bugs.title: Async repository used with a synchronous session
bugs.reason: BaseRepository is fully async (AsyncSession, await self.session.execute(...)), but db_dependency yields a synchronous sqlmodel.Session. Even after adding await, `await session.execute()` on a sync session errors.
bugs.fix: Pick one model: async engine + AsyncSession + async sessionmaker, or convert the repository to synchronous calls.

bugs.title: Dependency swallows exceptions and never rolls back
bugs.reason: db_dependency wraps yield in `except Exception` and only prints. In a FastAPI yield-dependency this suppresses exceptions raised by the route (including HTTPException), so 404s/validation errors don't propagate correctly, and there is no rollback.
bugs.fix: Remove the broad except, or rollback() and re-raise so FastAPI can handle the error.

bugs.title: Missing pydantic-settings and other used packages
bugs.reason: config.py imports `from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings`, but pydantic-settings is not listed; import fails without it. Also missing a Postgres driver if ARRAY/Postgres is kept, and PyJWT + cryptography used by security.py.
bugs.fix: Add pydantic-settings (and psycopg2-binary/PyJWT/cryptography as needed) to requirements.txt.

bugs.title: ORM table model used as response_model; unused import
bugs.reason: response_model=list[ProjectModel] uses the SQLModel table model as the response schema instead of ProjectRead, bypassing the schemas layer and exposing the DB model. Session imported from sqlalchemy.orm on line 2 is unused.
bugs.fix: Use `response_model=list[ProjectRead]` and remove the unused Session import.

bugs.title: Non-Pydantic mixin used in a Pydantic model
bugs.reason: ProjectRead(ProjectBase, BaseDBMetadata) mixes in BaseDBMetadata, which is a plain class, not a Pydantic BaseModel; id/created_at may not behave as reliable validated fields.
bugs.fix: Make BaseDBMetadata a BaseModel (with model_config from_attributes=True) or define id/created_at directly on ProjectRead.

bugs.title: Leftover debug print
bugs.reason: `print(cryptography.__builtins__)` runs on import and is debug leftover.

bugs.file: app/dependencies.py, app/exceptions.py, app/middleware.py, app/api/router.py, app/api/v1/router.py, app/core/base.py, app/core/logging.py
bugs.title: Empty/unwired stub files
bugs.reason: Several files are empty or import-only scaffolding that is never wired up. Not bugs, but incomplete and misleading.
bugs.fix: Implement and wire them, or remove until needed.
